'''Ridgetown''' was a major [[City/Legends|city]] built around the [[Rotoksa Ridge Grand Lodge]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sakiya]]. It was inhabited primarily by [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyans]] who sought admittance to the Lodge, and contained dozens of shops and [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]].<ref name="LoNH" />
